snippet.title: AI Roads, Forts, Mercs & More - Imperator: Invictus DD#97
snippet.description:
Massive AI improvements in Imperator: Invictus 1.10.1, already available! Advanced AI, roads, forts – and an overview of all AI updates.
Watch the 97th dev diary by Anbeeld, the mod's AI guy, known for his Victoria 3 mods: Anbeeld's Revision of AI and Stockpile Economy.

Imperator: Invictus is a grand modpack and community update to Imperator: Rome, a grand strategy by Paradox Interactive.

0:00 Welcome to the dev diary!
0:44 Advanced AI
2:22 AI road building
4:12 AI fort placement
6:38 Overview of AI improvements
  7:00 Building priorities
  7:32 Invention priorities
  7:56 Law changing system
  8:14 Character loyalty management
  8:29 Cities and metropolises
  8:46 Province investments
  9:03 National ideas
  9:11 Diplomatic stances
  9:21 Governor policies
  9:34 Economic policies
  9:54 Various issues fixed
  10:12 No cheating for the AI
10:30 Closing thoughts

Imperator: Invictus in Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2532715348
Text version of this dev diary: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-imperator-invictus.1473328/page-89#post-30750649
Join Invictus Discord: https://discord.gg/5K9fd3qSjx

Imperator: Invictus as a team project DOES NOT accept donations.
You can support Anbeeld personally here: https://anbeeld.com/support

Previous dev diaries about AI improvements:
1.9.1 https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-imperator-invictus.1473328/page-82#post-30180040
1.9.2 https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-imperator-invictus.1473328/page-84#post-30234654
1.10 https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-imperator-invictus.1473328/page-87#post-30615638

More dev diaries about the 1.10.1 update:
95th - Map visuals polishing and new unit models https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-imperator-invictus.1473328/page-89#post-30724272
96th - Military experience and Black Sea map changes https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-imperator-invictus.1473328/page-89#post-30738654
